qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Maintainer-named full-platform test run (front end, back end, and the new-user local project flow), 2026-11-10. Text only; screenshots were live judgment aids and are not attached.

## Environment fingerprint

- framework `ff04ad811da5` (console built from `ui/` in the same tree, `pnpm build --concurrency=2` then `pnpm console:build`)
- showcase boots, each on its own port and file DB: `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch -p PORT -d file:/tmp/RUN/data.db`, `OS_PORT` and `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT` exported (runner B also `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1`; runner A also one `OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true` boot and one `OS_DISABLE_SIGNUP=true --no-seed-admin` boot)
- boot banner: `Seeds: com.example.showcase 138 rows`, `33 flow(s) 21 bound`, 0 ERROR lines, 76 author-time warnings
- new-user leg: the published `create-objectstack@18.3.0` scaffold, outside the monorepo
- runners: four parallel subagents (API A, API B, browser C, cloud D — cloud's record is filed in objectstack-ai/cloud) plus the dispatching session; no runner shared a port, DB or browser

## Scope

Selector `all` over the active ledger: 355 runnable items (blocked included, planned excluded). Unpinned P0 and P1 items in every area were driven by hand where the runner reached them; P0 pins listed below were executed; P2 items were not driven. The one planned item is not counted.

## Pins executed

- `packages/qa/dogfood`: showcase-anonymous-deny-surfaces, showcase-private-owd, showcase-public-read-owd, owner-anchor-and-bulk-writes, showcase-static-readonly, showcase-readonly-when-parent, showcase-crud-persona-matrix, packaged-activation-ledger-reach, showcase-invoice-line-contributor-pair → 9 files, 195 tests passed (HTTP layer, in-process stack)
- `objectstack verify --rls` on the showcase → exit 0, CRUD `15 verified, 0 gaps, 0 FAILED, 1 needs-fixture, 8 skipped`; per-persona line `19 PROVEN (19 consistent, 0 HOLES)`; total line `all personas: 34 PROVEN (34 consistent, 0 HOLES) · 230 NOT PROVEN`. The 8 skipped objects are the defect extracted below (verify's own boot drops 26 seed rows).
- `examples/app-showcase` Playwright smoke → 54 passed, 2 failed; both failures are `mobile-signin-handoff.spec.ts`, which needs `OS_TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES` on the server and my reused boot did not set it (invalid pairing, not a product defect).

## Reproduction rule — platform-core.console-login clause [3]

1. Sign in through the form at `/_console/login` (admin, or `auditor.demo@example.com` / `showcase123`); wait for `/_console/home`.
2. `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-out` → 200.
3. Without reloading, click the "Showcase" tile on Home (or any sidebar link).
- Expected: the console returns to the login page (or shows a re-authentication prompt).
- Actual: every API call answers 401, the full shell stays (sidebar, avatar, notification badge), and the main area reads "Page Not Found — The page \"showcase_capability_map\" could not be found. It may have been removed or renamed."; object lists read "Couldn't load records … Check your connection and try again". Only a full reload goes to `/login?redirect=…`.
- Reproduced three times, two personas, ref-targeted clicks. Disposition: product defect (extracted).

## Off-clause probes

About 15% of each runner's time, same boots, personas admin / members / manager / exec / ops / anonymous. Doors: data, batch, shares, auth, keys, forms, meta, automation, approvals, webhooks, uploads, search, MCP. Boundary classes: empty, unknown and oversized ids, malformed JSON, unknown query params, negative and huge limits, SQL- and script-shaped values, wrong persona, concurrent decisions, forged anchors.

- access-security · probe · security finding — detail withheld, reported to PM
- integration-system.webhook-lifecycle · probe · security finding — detail withheld, reported to PM
- api-backend · probe · security finding — detail withheld, reported to PM
- search.console-global-search · probe · security finding — detail withheld, reported to PM
- product defects found by probes are extracted as their own cards (close-out comment lists them)

## Fixture gaps and checklist-accuracy notes (for the wave's anchor, not extracted)

- platform-core.seed-integrity baseline says 132 rows / 19 datasets; the boot reads 138 rows / 20 datasets and `showcase_invoice_line` authors 7 lines.
- identity-auth.session-list-revoke step 3: revoke takes the `token` from `list-sessions`, not the `set-auth-token` bearer (that answers 404).
- integration-system.webhook-lifecycle: redeliver's body key is `deliveryId`; the scratch webhook's secret goes in `signing_secret` / `headers_secret`; the column is `active`, not `is_active`.
- api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix: no null `annual_revenue` in the seed, so count-`*` vs count-field cannot discriminate.
- platform-core.console-login step 5 should name both an in-app navigation and a reload; they behave differently.
- records-forms.crud-roundtrip: `hq` is a location field; name a rule-free text field for the single-field edit.
- Recurring fixture debt: the contributor-bound member, a walled boot, a credentialed external database, a broken-upstream scratch app.
- `examples/app-showcase/playwright.config.ts` reuses an existing server without `OS_TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES`, so `mobile-signin-handoff.spec.ts` fails by construction on a reused boot.
